name: @exprtlabs/golem-ts-openapi
description: Generate OpenAPI documents from TypeScript controllers without starting the application
author: exprtlabs.ai

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const target of ['dist', '../../.build/golem-ts-openapi.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build && tsc -p ../../tsconfig.package-check.json && node ../../.build/scripts/verify-package.js .
